villagemaster/30512.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I'm Head Blacksmith Kusto of the Black Anvil Guild here in Gludin. Unlike the Iron Gate Guild, our Black Anvil Guild is interested in more than simply profit. The joy in creating something beautiful should sometimes take precedence over the prospect of a few gold coins, don't…

Q00183_RelicExploration/30512-01.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: My trade is a very competitive one. I believed that the lost knowledge of the Giants would benefit me and all those with interests in the Black Anvil Guild...

Q00183_RelicExploration/30512-03.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: My trade is a very competitive one. I believed that the lost knowledge of the Giants would benefit me and all those with interests in the Black Anvil Guild... Are you not interested in those things? (Only characters level 40 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q00183_RelicExploration/30512-05.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Please find Researcher Lorain in the Tower of Cruma. She will give you the details about how you can help her. Good luck!

Q00187_NikolasHeart/30512-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Long time no see! Do you have any good news?

links.text: "I heard that you also gave Nikola some work."

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30512-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Long time no see. How is Lorain progressing with her assignment?

Q00190_LostDream/30512-01.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Good to see you again! When I decoded the metal plate that you gave me, it turned out to be a research log from the lab. I still need to check something, however. Would you help me?

Q00190_LostDream/30512-02.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: How are you? I certainly appreciate the assistance you provided me. If I need your help again, I won't hesitate to ask! In the meantime, I must take my leave... (Only characters level 42 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q00190_LostDream/30512-04.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Why are you still here? There is no time to waste. Go find Magister Juris in the town of Giran and ask her about the last Cruma. If you are having second thoughts, I will ask somebody else to go.

Q00190_LostDream/30512-05.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Did you find her? She does know something about the Cruma, doesn't she?

Q00190_LostDream/30512-07.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Please do not waste any more time! Tell Lorain that the work I asked her to do is finished.

Q00190_LostDream/30512-08.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Thank you for your help, my friend. Please take this as a small token of my gratitude. I should be happy to work with you again if the opportunity arises in the future. Farewell!

Q00191_VainConclusion/30512-01.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Long time no see. How is Lorain progressing with her assignment?

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30512-01a.h.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I have heard many impressive tales of your clan... I would be greatly honored to meet the lord of your clan.

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30512-01.ht.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I've heard about your clan... you are the Clan in high spirits, no? I heard that you were headed towards Death Pass...? I'll be counting on you. Please find my brother. He received the title of honorable Bounty Hunter... These days he hangs out with a bad crowd called the Mag…

links.text: "Tell me more about the Magpie Brothers."

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30512-04.ht.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I will never forget your kindness in bringing me the news of my poor brother. I hope that the guild can help you someday.

Q00183_RelicExploration/30512-02.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I allied myself with Lorain, a member of the Bronze Key Guild. I promised that we would share equally any of the secrets we discovered in our quest. However, I think something terrible has recently happened to her. Would you help me?

Q00183_RelicExploration/30512-04.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Lorain is stationed just outside the entrance to Cruma Tower studying the technology of the ancient Giants. I believe, however, that the monsters who inhabit the Tower are threatening her safety...and interrupting her research. Would you help her? Please, I beg of you... (Ple…

Q00187_NikolasHeart/30512-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Ha ha! I don't know how you found that out. Well... since you already know, I will tell you. I wouldn't mind if Nikola and Lorain would work together, actually, but since they despise each other I thought it best to let them work separately. But as you discovered, this is not…

links.text: "That problem has been resolved. I found something that looks like a relic, but we need the password."

Q00187_NikolasHeart/30512-03.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: Ah! Let me see it! Hmm. I see. Yes, we certainly need the password. It might take me some time, but I think I can puzzle it out. Excellent work, my young friend! Please accept this as a token of my gratitude. Farewell -- I must take this to my lab!

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30512-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I see. Hmm... Researching Cruma, eh? Interesting... Although there is nothing to be gained financially from it, unfortunately... But I suppose the research may still have some value, eh? Thank you for your help. Please take this in exchange for what you've done. I will send w…

Q00190_LostDream/30512-03.htm.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: The research log on the metal plate contains a record of the Cruma, one of the ancient creatures born at the creation of the world. I have determined to ask the Elves about the location of the last Cruma. Magister Juris in the town of Giran may know something about this matte…

Q00190_LostDream/30512-06.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I see... So it really is extinct. As I told you before, I doubt there is anything to be gained financially from this line of research. Still, any knowledge must possess some value, don't you think? In any event, thank you for your efforts. I have one final favor to ask of you…

Q00191_VainConclusion/30512-02.html.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: I see. Hmm... Researching Cruma, eh? Interesting... Although there is nothing to be gained financially from it, unfortunately... Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30512-03.ht.text: Head Blacksmith Kusto: They don't respect their ancestors. They are bounty hunters who dig up graves and rummage through relics to collect anything that's valuable. They were named the Magpie's Brothers because of their greed. They even hoarded relics from the Dwarf Kingdom found in the ancient lab…
